newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIAN POLICE HAULS DRUGS FROM TEA SHIPMENT.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIAN POLICE HAULS DRUGS FROM TEA SHIPMENT.

text.p: Customs police in Romania's Black Sea port of Constanta seized 1.3 tonnes of hashish hidden in a container carrying tea, police said on Friday.
The drugs were concealed in the walls of the container, Constanta police spokesman Marian Saragea said. He declined to name the ship which carried the container, or the origin of the shipment.
He said the drugs consignment was transiting Romania, on the so-called "Balkan route", on its way to the West.
"Drugs are smuggled into Romania via the port and re-routed by land to Western destinations through our western borders with Hungary in the county of Bihor," Saragea said.

Bihor police seized 4.5 tonnes of hashish on their way to Hungary last year, but the biggest such haul was in 1993 when 11 tonnes of hashish and cannabis were seized by Constanta port police aboard a ship bound for the Netherlands. REUTER
